The evidence supports a mechanistic pathway where Mulberrofuran G may act as a modulator of Mcl-1, which subsequently impacts Tyrosine--tRNA ligase. However, the exact nature of the interaction between Mulberrofuran G and Mcl-1 remains unclear, and further experimental validation would be necessary to confirm the direct or indirect role of Mulberrofuran G in regulating Tyrosine--tRNA ligase.
